Sodium hypochlorite is not held for more than 30 days at any plant: it loses strength in storage. Ferric chloride and caustic tanks are sized for 21 to 35 days at average use. A plant may not take a delivery that would fill a tank above 90%.

INTER-SITE TRANSFER PROCEDURE
A stock transport order moves stock between sites of any business at standard cost; no margin is charged between businesses. The receiving site pays the freight. The holding site's storeroom lead confirms the release, and the holding site must stay at or above its own safety stock. Bulk chemicals move by tanker between plants only with process safety sign-off.
